description: Source code for ShaderStorageBlockOutputHLSL class, which handles translation of SSBO access chains to offsets in HLSL shader code, including functions for traversing and generating code for shader storage buffer objects in the ANGLE graphics project.

classes.name: ShaderStorageBlockOutputHLSL
classes.description: Class responsible for translating shader storage buffer object (SSBO) access chains into HLSL code offsets, managing traversal and code generation for SSBO operations.

classes.name: BlockInfoVisitor
classes.description: Helper class for visiting block layout information and mapping shader variables to block members during code generation.

methods.name: GetBlockLayoutInfo
methods.description: Recursively retrieves layout info for a node, including storage type and row-major flag.

methods.name: GetBlockMemberInfoByType
methods.description: Encodes type information into block member info based on storage and layout.

methods.name: GetFieldMemberInShaderStorageBlock
methods.description: Finds a field in a shader storage block by variable name.

methods.name: FindInterfaceBlock
methods.description: Finds an interface block in a list by name.

methods.name: StripArrayIndices
methods.description: Removes array index notation from variable names.

methods.name: MapVariableToField
methods.description: Maps shader variables to struct fields recursively.

methods.name: GetShaderStorageBlockMembersInfo
methods.description: Collects info about shader storage block members for code generation.

methods.name: IsInArrayOfArraysChain
methods.description: Checks if a node is part of an array-of-arrays chain.

methods.name: ShaderStorageBlockOutputHLSL
methods.description: Main class for handling SSBO code translation in ANGLE, including traversal and code emission functions.

methods.name: outputStoreFunctionCallPrefix
methods.description: Starts code output for store function call.

methods.name: outputLoadFunctionCall
methods.description: Outputs code for load function call.

methods.name: outputLengthFunctionCall
methods.description: Outputs code for length function call.

methods.name: outputAtomicMemoryFunctionCallPrefix
methods.description: Outputs code for atomic memory function call prefix based on operation.

methods.name: setMatrixStride
methods.description: Calculates and sets matrix stride for a node.

methods.name: traverseSSBOAccess
methods.description: Traverses an SSBO access chain to generate corresponding HLSL code.

methods.name: writeShaderStorageBlocksHeader
methods.description: Outputs header code for shader storage blocks.

methods.name: isEndOfSSBOAccessChain
methods.description: Determines if current node is at the end of an SSBO access chain.

methods.name: visitSymbol
methods.description: Handles symbol nodes during traversal.

methods.name: visitConstantUnion
methods.description: Handles constant union nodes during traversal.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Handles aggregate nodes during traversal.

methods.name: visitTernary
methods.description: Handles ternary nodes during traversal.

methods.name: visitUnary
methods.description: Handles unary nodes during traversal.

methods.name: visitSwizzle
methods.description: Handles swizzle nodes during traversal.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Handles binary nodes during traversal.

methods.name: writeEOpIndexDirectOrIndirectOutput
methods.description: Generates code for index direct or indirect SSBO access.

methods.name: writeDotOperatorOutput
